entries.title: II Chronicles 17:1
segments: ¶And Jehoshaphat his son became king in his place, and made himself strong against Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:2
segments: He put forces in all the walled towns of Judah, and responsible chiefs in the land of Judah and in the towns of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:3
segments: And the Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he went in the early ways of his father, not turning to the Baals,

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:4
segments: But turning to the God of his father and keeping his laws, and not doing as Israel did.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:5
segments: So the Lord made his kingdom strong; and all Judah gave offerings to Jehoshaphat, and he had great wealth and honour.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:6
segments: His heart was lifted up in the ways of the Lord; and he went so far as to take away the high places and the wood pillars out of Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:7
segments: In the third year of his rule he sent Benhail and Obadiah and Zechariah and Nethanel and Micaiah, his captains, as teachers into the towns of Judah;

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:8
segments: And with them, Shemaiah and Nethaniah and Zebadiah and Asahel and Shemiramoth and Jehonathan and Adonijah and Tobijah and Tob-adonijah, the Levites; and Elishama and Jehoram the priests.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:9
segments: And they gave teaching in Judah and had the book of the law of the Lord with them; they went through all the towns of Judah teaching the people.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:10
segments: ¶And the fear of the Lord was on all the kingdoms of the lands round Judah, so that they made no wars against Jehoshaphat.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:11
segments: And some of the Philistines took offerings to Jehoshaphat, and made him payments of silver; and the Arabians gave him flocks, seven thousand, seven hundred sheep, and seven thousand, seven hundred he-goats.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:12
segments: Jehoshaphat became greater and greater, and made strong towers and store-towns in Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:13
segments: He had much property in the towns of Judah; he had forces of armed men, great and strong, in Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:14
segments: This is the number of them, listed by their families, the captains of thousands of Judah: Adnah, the captain, and with him three hundred thousand men of war;

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:15
segments: Second to him Jehohanan, the captain, and with him two hundred and eighty thousand;

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:16
segments: After him Amasiah, the son of Zichri, who freely gave himself to the Lord, and with him two hundred thousand men of war;

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:17
segments: And the captains of Benjamin: Eliada, a great man of war, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bows and body-covers;

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:18
segments: And after him Jehozabad, and with him a hundred and eighty thousand trained for war.

entries.title: II Chronicles 17:19
segments: These were the men who were waiting on the king, in addition to those placed by the king in the walled towns through all Judah.
